name: Bug report

title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''

---

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what went wrong.

## Steps to reproduce

1. What you asked the agent to do (or the command you ran)
2. ...
3. What happened

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen instead.

## Where

The file(s) involved, e.g. a `SKILL.md` or `references/...` section, a script and its
command line, or a template under `assets/`.

## Environment

- Agent client and version: [e.g. Claude Code 2.x]
- OS: [e.g. Linux, macOS, Windows/WSL]
- Python version: [e.g. 3.11]
- benchmark-builder commit: [output of `git rev-parse --short HEAD`]

## Additional context

Logs, a minimal benchmark that reproduces it, or anything else that helps.
